welcomeDesc: Add a few things you have watched so your library, progress and recommendations feel useful from the start.
skipHint: You can always find this again in Settings.
skipFailed: Could not save your choice. Please try again.
modeWatchedHint: Tap posters of things you have watched.
modeWatchlistHint: Tap posters of things you want to watch.
noSuggestions: Nothing to suggest right now — try searching instead.
loadErrorDesc: Check your connection and try again. You can also skip and do this later.
progressDesc: Shows are marked as caught up by default. Only adjust the ones you stopped partway through.
noShowsToReview: No shows to review — continue to the summary.
noAiredEpisodes: No aired episodes available yet for this show.
reviewDesc: One tap adds everything to your library. Already-tracked titles are kept as they are.
summaryNote: Episodes are counted when applied — specials and unaired episodes are never marked.
applyFailed: Could not apply your selections. Nothing was lost — try again.
doneDesc: Your Shows, Movies, Watch Next and Stats screens now have something to work with.
doneUnresolved: {{count}} titles could not be fully resolved — you can add them from their pages.
tooMany: You can add up to 100 shows and 100 movies at once — remove some selections first.
